findings.title: Account save allows modification of any account via ID injection

evidence.why: Takes full object from request without verifying ownership
Saves the provided object ID directly to DB without checking if current user owns it

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST /account/save with an Account object containing User B's account ID. The server saves User B's account details, allowing User A to modify them.
findings.impact: Modification of other users' accounts (e.g., changing names, emails, or associated data).
findings.recommendation: Verify that the account being saved belongs to the authenticated user before persisting changes.
